Retro-PC-Gehäuse (Mac Mini One)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/477292-retro-pc-case-mac-mini-one#profileId-388339

因为这个项目用到了很多可能只能在中国大陆才能买到的附件，所以大家可以下载之后自行修改适配自己方便采购的设备。
Since this project has modified many accessories that may only be available in mainland China, you can download and purchase your own equipment later.

主机：Macmini

屏幕：来自surface go的拆机屏/Screen: disassembled screen from surface go

读卡器扩展口：UGREEN/Card reader expansion port: UGREEN

开关按钮：40cm机械式相机快门线/Switch button: 40cm mechanical grating line

PD充电器：30W(扩展屏使用）/PD charger: 30W(for Extended screen)

开关：卡扣型开关/Switch: snap-type switch

USB-2.5G网卡/USB-2.5G network adapter:

键盘使用的是Keychron Q4Pro ，目前键盘外壳模型尚未上传。

The keyboard uses a Keychron Q4Pro, and the keyboard case model has not yet been uploaded.

 

后续会发布视频展示整个的组装过程，并将其适配其他屏幕。
A video will be released later to show the entire assembly process and adapt it to other screens.
 

 

如果你觉得太复杂，也可以先打印一个鼠标，使用拓竹002套件：
If you think it is too complicated, you can also print a mouse first and use the Bamblab 002 kit:

https://makerworld.com/zh/models/471517#profileId-381142

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: main case
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 4
- Infill: 25%
- Filament: PETG (#FFFFFF), PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#808080)
